description: Dark, gripping and morally complex Dra-a.The life of brilliant judge Micha Alkoby is heading down a promising path, with a promotion coming soon. It all changes after his teenage son, Shay, is involved in a hit-and-run, in which he is the guilty party. Just as Micha is about to turn Shay in, he learns the victim is a member of a crime family, the kind that runs its own system of justice.

cast.name: 伊兰尼特·本雅克夫 Ilanit Ben-Yaakov
